A quick guide to tracking your work effectively
On the Dashboard, click Full Day or Half Day to mark today\'s attendance. Add overtime using the + / - buttons before saving. If you didn\'t work, click Mark Absent.
Your Earnings are automatically calculated by multiplying your working days with your Daily Wage. Net Payable shows your final take-home amount: (Total Earnings - Advance).
If you receive money ahead of time, click Add Advance on the Dashboard or add it directly on a specific date inside the Calendar. This is automatically deducted.
Use the Calendar to edit past records (e.g. if you forgot to mark attendance yesterday). Use Passbook to export your monthly logs as a PDF or CSV.

WorkDaily is committed to protecting your privacy through an offline-first architecture. This Privacy Policy details how your local information, notifications, exported files, and preferences are handled when you use the WorkDaily Android application.

All information entered by you—including profile name, optional profile avatar photo, mobile phone number, daily wage configurations, attendance logs, overtime hours, advance payments, notes, and app preferences—is stored on your device inside Room SQLite database, DataStore preferences, and app-private internal storage. WorkDaily operates without a remote backend server, user account requirement, or external application analytics server. Standard Android Auto Backup and device-to-device migration features provided by the Android OS may back up app data to your private Google cloud account according to your system settings.

WorkDaily uses system AlarmManager and WorkManager to deliver local attendance reminders and summary alerts directly on your device. Notification content is generated 100% locally on your device and may dynamically include user-configured wage rates or calculated work summaries. You can grant or revoke notification permissions at any time in Android Settings.

PDF Passbook reports and ZIP backup packages are compiled locally on your device. When you choose to export or share a PDF report or backup ZIP file, you select the destination application or storage location using the Android system Sharesheet. WorkDaily does not automatically upload or transmit your backup files to external servers.

WorkDaily does not integrate third-party analytics SDKs, advertising networks, crash reporting SDKs, tracking frameworks, or cloud synchronization services. Internet network permissions are used solely when you explicitly initiate external contact actions (such as opening the WhatsApp channel, Instagram page, or launching an email client to contact support).

Your information remains stored on your local device for as long as the application remains installed, or until you explicitly edit or delete individual records or clear application storage. Uninstalling WorkDaily removes internal database records and local profile assets from your physical device (subject to system-level Android Auto Backup retention if enabled on your device). User-created backup ZIP files stored in downloads or external folders must be managed or deleted manually by the user.

WorkDaily is designed for working individuals, employees, supervisors, and contractors to manage daily wage records. WorkDaily does not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from children under the age of 13.
If you have any questions or feedback regarding this Privacy Policy or data handling in WorkDaily, please contact the WorkDaily support team at workdaily.synfusion@gmail.com.

By accessing, logging in, or using the WorkDaily application, you confirm that you have read and agree to be bound by these Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to these Terms, you must not use the application.

WorkDaily is a productivity and personal record-keeping application intended to help users record and manage information such as daily attendance, work days, daily wages, overtime hours, advances, employment-related notes, and financial/earning records entered by the user. WorkDaily is provided solely as a personal record-keeping software tool and is not a financial institution, bank, employer, payroll processor, accounting authority, tax advisor, legal service, or government agency.

You are solely responsible for all information you enter into WorkDaily, including accuracy, completeness, correct dates, correct attendance statuses, correct wage amounts, correct overtime hours, correct advance cash draws, correct employment notes, and keeping your records updated where necessary. WorkDaily does not independently verify or validate information entered by users.\n\nPractical Verification Warning: Users should review and verify all important records, calculations, and summaries before relying on them for payment settlements, employment claims, accounting, tax, legal, financial, or other consequential purposes.

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, WorkDaily and its developer/founder are not responsible for losses, damages, disputes, or consequences arising from inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or incorrectly entered user data, misunderstood calculations, unverified records, or a user\'s failure to review records before relying on them for external financial or employment decisions.

WorkDaily is provided as a software tool on an \"as is\" and \"as available\" basis. While reasonable efforts are made to ensure mathematical accuracy, no software can guarantee absolute error-free operation under all device configurations. Calculations and summaries should be reviewed independently and should not be treated as the sole authoritative source for legally or financially significant records.

WorkDaily operates 100% offline without remote cloud backup. You are solely responsible for creating and maintaining regular ZIP backup files using the in-app backup feature and securing your physical device. The developer cannot recover data lost due to device damage, OS resets, uninstallation, or lost backup files.
All intellectual property rights, trademarks, branding, user interface designs, and code in WorkDaily belong exclusively to WorkDaily and its developer/founder.
For questions regarding these Terms of Use, please contact support at workdaily.synfusion@gmail.com.
